map.由系统与外界熵变求熵产 使用指南: Entropy Generation from System and Surroundings - User Guide
map.输入系统熵变与热源（环境）熵变，计算总熵产 S_gen，验证是否 ≥0 以判定过: Enter system entropy change and heat-source (surroundings) entropy change; compute total entropy generation S_gen, verify ≥0 to judge process direction and irreversible loss, for isolated-system entropy analysis.
map.S_gen = ΔS_sys + ΔS_surr ≥ 0。 系统 +10、环境: S_gen = ΔS_sys + ΔS_surr ≥ 0. System +10, environment -9 -> S_gen=+1.
map.输入系统熵变与热源熵变，求熵产（应 ≥0）。: Enter system entropy change and heat-source entropy change to find entropy generation (should be ≥0).
map.系统熵变与环境熵变之和是否非负。: Whether the sum of system and surroundings entropy changes is non-negative.
map.检验过程是否满足第二定律。: Check whether the process satisfies the second law.
map.不可逆性量化（熵产越大损失越大）。: Quantify irreversibility (larger entropy generation means greater loss).
map.：ΔS_sys=10, ΔS_surr=−9 J/K：S_gen=10+(−9): : ΔS_sys = 10, ΔS_surr = -9 J/K: S_gen = 10 + (-9) = 1 J/K ≥ 0, satisfies the second law.
map.：若 S_gen<0 则过程不可能发生（如热量自发从冷到热）。: : If S_gen < 0 the process is impossible (e.g., heat spontaneously flowing cold to hot).
map.自然对流驱动力无量纲数: Dimensionless number of natural convection driving force
map.孤立系统总熵不减，S_gen≥0 是过程可行判据。: Total entropy of an isolated system does not decrease; S_gen≥0 is the feasibility criterion.
map.熵产对应作功能力损失（T0·S_gen），是㶲损失度量。: Entropy generation corresponds to lost work ability (T0·S_gen), a measure of exergy loss.
